name: filter-chips
title: Filter Chips
description: Filters as chips in a FilterBar: one chip per active filter that opens an editor for its field, a button that removes it, Add filter for the others, and reset. Picks apply at once; typed values on Enter or when the editor closes.
docs: Inside a `ServerDataTable` with `filterUi="chips"`, or a `FilterScope`, it reads the schema and controller (or pass `schema` and `controller`). Each chip's text is its name, "Status: Open, Blocked" (`labels.chip`, with `summarizeFilter` for the value), and opens a popover with the field's `FilterField`; a choice applies at once, a typed text or number on Enter or when the popover closes. Its remove button, "Remove Status filter", clears the field and returns focus to Add filter, a menu of the fields without a value: choosing one opens its editor, and leaving it empty adds nothing. The toolbar is one tab stop with arrow keys (UI SDK Toolbar), named by `labels.toolbar`, and Reset filters shows while any chip applies. `fields` limits and orders the fields offered (every field but the search field by default); `valueLabels` names remote option ids it hasn't loaded. Labels default to English and can be overridden.
